messages.text: On my natal chart, where is Chiron?

In your natal chart, Chiron is located in Leo in the 10th house. This placement suggests that your deepest wounds and healing journey are connected to your sense of self-expression and public image. You might feel a strong need to prove yourself and gain recognition in your career or public life, yet also feel vulnerable about your abilities in these areas. Healing can come from embracing your creative talents and finding ways to express yourself authentically.

In your natal chart, you have Pluto in Scorpio in the 1st house. This placement indicates a powerful and intense personality, with a strong presence and transformative energy. You might experience significant personal transformations throughout your life and have a deep understanding of the darker aspects of life and human nature. This placement can also suggest a strong will and the ability to influence and inspire others.
